reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in their DM. Nothing has been sent; it stays a draft until someone sends it.

- **What the draft says:** the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines is $2,356 a seat. It says Dana proposed it and Anselm cleared sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to pass it on without Anselm's or June's OK.
- **Why no approval was needed:** Hollis leads the Central team, and Dana owns this account, so normally Hollis would need approval to see this rate. Anselm is one of the two people who can give that approval, and his message did. Hollis's address is internal, so Ruth's approval for outside mail doesn't apply.
- **The figure isn't confirmed:** the $2,356 rate came only from Anselm's message. I didn't check it against a contract or order form, and I told Anselm that.
